evidence_quotes.O: Firstly, I am not an audiophile. I enjoy a good sound system, but it isn't a point of pride or anything like that for me.
evidence_quotes.C: So, I took an Icom M36 as a backup. The boat's installed radio turned out to be perfectly fine and its much higher antennae (top of the mast) provided great reception.
evidence_quotes.E: It was nice to make dinner reservations (this was in the British Virgin Islands, aka BVI) via VHF while taking the dinghy between harbors and stuff.
evidence_quotes.A: I used to be a Sony fan. I bought this thing because of the Sony label. No more. The Sony brand has lost it.
evidence_quotes.N: Executive Summary: Works as expected so far, no drama.
